# pvecli cluster firewall

Manage the firewall of the datacenter.

## status

Show the firewall of every level of the cluster, and what is not enforced.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall status [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## enable

Turn the firewall of the datacenter on. Checks the API stays reachable.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall enable [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## disable

Turn the firewall of the datacenter off.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall disable [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## set

Change firewall options: policies, log levels, filters.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall set [SETTINGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `SETTINGS` | KEY=VALUE pairs, as `options` names them. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--clear VALUE` | Options back to their default, comma separated. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## rule list

List the firewall rules, in the order they are evaluated.

```text

```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-g`, `--group VALUE` | Rules of this security group. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## rule add

Add a firewall rule (asked step by step without --action).

```text
pvecli cluster firewall rule add [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-ac`, `--action VALUE` |  | ACCEPT, DROP, REJECT, or a security group to insert. |
| `-dn`, `--direction VALUE` |  | in, out or forward. |
| `-ma`, `--macro VALUE` |  | A macro (cluster firewall macros): SSH, HTTPS. |
| `-pt`, `--proto VALUE` |  | Protocol: tcp, udp, icmp... or a number. |
| `-src`, `--source VALUE` |  | Source: address, network, alias or +ipset. |
| `-dst`, `--dest VALUE` |  | Destination: address, network, alias or +ipset. |
| `-spt`, `--sport VALUE` |  | Source port(s): 80, 80:90, 22,80. |
| `-dpt`, `--dport VALUE` |  | Destination port(s): 443, 8000:8100, 22,443. |
| `--icmp-type VALUE` |  | ICMP type, with --proto icmp. |
| `--iface VALUE` |  | Interface: net0 on a guest, vmbr0 on a node. |
| `-lg`, `--log VALUE` |  | Log level: emerg, alert, crit, err, warning, notice, info, debug, nolog. |
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` |  | Comment. |
| `-po`, `--pos N` | `0` | Position: 0 is evaluated first (the default, like the web interface). |
| `--disabled` |  | Add it disabled. |
| `-g`, `--group VALUE` |  | Rules of this security group. |
| `-f`, `--force` |  | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## rule edit

Change a firewall rule: only the options given change.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall rule edit [POSITION] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `POSITION` | Position of the rule. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-ac`, `--action VALUE` | ACCEPT, DROP, REJECT, or a security group to insert. |
| `-dn`, `--direction VALUE` | in, out or forward. |
| `-ma`, `--macro VALUE` | A macro (cluster firewall macros): SSH, HTTPS. |
| `-pt`, `--proto VALUE` | Protocol: tcp, udp, icmp... or a number. |
| `-src`, `--source VALUE` | Source: address, network, alias or +ipset. |
| `-dst`, `--dest VALUE` | Destination: address, network, alias or +ipset. |
| `-spt`, `--sport VALUE` | Source port(s): 80, 80:90, 22,80. |
| `-dpt`, `--dport VALUE` | Destination port(s): 443, 8000:8100, 22,443. |
| `--icmp-type VALUE` | ICMP type, with --proto icmp. |
| `--iface VALUE` | Interface: net0 on a guest, vmbr0 on a node. |
| `-lg`, `--log VALUE` | Log level: emerg, alert, crit, err, warning, notice, info, debug, nolog. |
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` | Comment. |
| `--clear VALUE` | Fields to empty, comma separated: macro, proto, source, dest, sport, dport, icmp-type, iface, log, comment. |
| `-g`, `--group VALUE` | Rules of this security group. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## ipset add

Create an IP set and add entries to it.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall ipset add NAME [CIDRS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | IP set name (created if missing). |
| `CIDRS` | Addresses, networks or alias names to add. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--nomatch` | Add them as exceptions (never match). |
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` | Comment of the entries, or of a new set. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## ipset edit

Change the comment or the name of an IP set.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall ipset edit [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | IP set name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` | Comment. |
| `--rename VALUE` | New name: every rule that names the set follows. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## ipset remove

Remove entries from an IP set, or the whole set.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall ipset remove [NAME] [CIDRS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | IP set name. |
| `CIDRS` | Entries to remove; none removes the whole set. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` | Remove the set even if rules name it. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

```text

```

### Options

|:--|:--|

## import

Make the firewall of the cluster match a file: only the levels it names.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall import FILE [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `FILE` | A file written by cluster firewall export. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine, or objects removed are still used by levels outside the file. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |
